newsitem.title: USA: Tarrant Apparel says venue transferred.
newsitem.headline: Tarrant Apparel says venue transferred.

text.p: Tarrant Apparel Group said Tuesday it had been granted a motion to transfer venue of a civil lawsuit from Los Angeles, Calif., to Columbus, Ohio.
United States District Court for the Central District of California granted the motion to transfer the suit, brought by the American Textile Manufacturers Institute.
Following transfer of the suit, a federal judge in Columbus will hear the case, including motions to dismiss.

"We are pleased by the court's decision to transfer venue in this case to Columbus, a decision we supported," said chief executive Gerard Guez. "We reiterate that Tarrant Apparel Group has a long standing policy to comply with the spirit and letter of all legal requirements relating to the importation of goods into the United States. We do not tolerate violation of any law and enforce compliance policies rigorously."
No further information was immediately available.
